name: OpenVoiceCS Leaderboard Claims

notes: Reference fixture claims are sanity checks for the harness and are not official leaderboard claims.
Official improvement claims must be backed by pairwise comparison evidence, release bundles, external-system registry entries, pricing evidence, and non-fixture judge evidence.

claims.statement: The deterministic oracle reference beats the deterministic no-op text baseline on the v0.1 public benchmark suite.
limitations: This is a reference sanity claim, not a third-party system claim.
It is expected to pass by construction and should not be included in official system rankings.

known_gaps: No official third-party leaderboard improvement claims are included in v0.1.
Official claims require external submissions, sealed evaluation, and non-fixture judging evidence.
